title: Coastal band example

jurisdictions.label: Coastal ecoregions
jurisdictions.aoi: SELECT DISTINCT h0, h8 FROM read_parquet('s3://public-coastal/meow-coastal-band/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet') WHERE ECO_CODE = {{ID}} AND dist_km <= {{WIDTH}}
jurisdictions.list: WITH c AS (SELECT DISTINCT CAST(ECO_CODE AS INTEGER) AS id, ECOREGION AS name, h3_cell_to_parent(h8, 5) AS h5 FROM read_parquet('s3://public-coastal/meow-coastal-band/hex/h0=*/data_0.parquet') WHERE dist_km <= {{WIDTH}}), p AS (SELECT id, name, h3_cell_to_lng(h5) AS x, h3_cell_to_lat(h5) AS y FROM c), g AS (SELECT id, ANY_VALUE(name) AS name, MIN(x) AS ax0, MAX(x) AS ax1, MIN((x + 360) % 360) AS sx0, MAX((x + 360) % 360) AS sx1, MIN(y) - 0.3 AS ymin, MAX(y) + 0.3 AS ymax FROM p GROUP BY id) SELECT id, name, CASE WHEN sx1 - sx0 < ax1 - ax0 THEN (CASE WHEN sx0 > 180 THEN sx0 - 360 ELSE sx0 END) ELSE ax0 END - 0.3 AS xmin, ymin, CASE WHEN sx1 - sx0 < ax1 - ax0 THEN (CASE WHEN sx1 > 180 THEN sx1 - 360 ELSE sx1 END) ELSE ax1 END + 0.3 AS xmax, ymax FROM g ORDER BY name

intro:
A minimal glen-charts app: pick any of the 220 coastal marine ecoregions (MEOW) by name or on the map, and a band width. The panel shows the band's sea and land area, depth and elevation, and where the ecoregion ranks among all of them.

Data: MEOW coastal band (derived from MEOW, CC-BY-NC-3.0, The Nature Conservancy / WWF; GEBCO 2025; Copernicus GLO-90).
